overall: The AG found the Board's April 25 executive session was held for a proper Purpose 3 litigation purpose, so the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session to discuss the merits of a memorandum submitted by his company, which fits no permissible purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Our review of the executive session minutes show that the Board discussed the merits of bringing affirmative litigation against ABC in Superior Court.

allegations.summary: Alternatively alleged the Board met to discuss a threat of suit that was not imminent, so the litigation purpose did not apply.
allegations.key_passage: A public body may meet in executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss whether or not to bring a lawsuit.
